claims: Amen Corner is the three-hole stretch consisting of holes 11, 12, and 13 at Augusta National Golf Club.
Amen Corner was coined by Herbert Warren Wind in 1958.
Herbert Warren Wind is a Sports Illustrated writer.
Amen Corner was named by Herbert Warren Wind inspired by the jazz tune "Shouting in That Amen Corner".
Hole 11 at Augusta National Golf Club is named White Dogwood.
Hole 11 at Augusta National Golf Club is a 520-yard par-4.
A pond guards the left side of the green on Hole 11 at Augusta National Golf Club.
Hole 12 at Augusta National Golf Club is named Golden Bell.
Hole 12 at Augusta National Golf Club is a 155-yard par-3.
Hole 12 at Augusta National Golf Club is over Rae's Creek.
Hole 12 at Augusta National Golf Club has a shallow green.
Hole 13 at Augusta National Golf Club is named Azalea.
Hole 13 at Augusta National Golf Club is a par-5.
A creek snakes in front of the green on Hole 13 at Augusta National Golf Club.
Amen Corner is the site of Rory McIlroy's collapse in 2011.
Amen Corner is the site of Jordan Spieth's collapse in 2016.
